items.title: 68728_Jonah
items.q: Charlie told me, "Those arrangements have still got your name on them, when you were supposed to come over there. Why didn't you come?"

ctx.x: Well, how did Charlie Shavers and Sy Oliver make out with him, did you ever find out?

No, I never knew too much about it. I know that Sy had made some stuff in there, called -- Charlie told me, "Those arrangements have still got your name on them, when you were supposed to come over there. Why didn't you come?" I said, "Well, we couldn't get together. We never got together, we didn't get into it very seriously, you know." I wasn't too particular about leaving Stuff anyway at the time. So he said, "Yeah, they've got about --," because Tommy told me, "Sy's already making some arrangements for you,…
